scan.title: What's in Our Classroom?
scan.subtitle: Find the right object!
sentences: Welcome to our classroom!
There is a teacher's desk at the front.
There are student desks for everyone.
There is a bookshelf near the window.
There are lockers on the wall.
There is a basket near the door.
How many lights are there? There are four lights.
Maya has a pen and a ruler on her desk.
Leo has a coursebook and a workbook.
There is a map on the wall.
There is a bin near the teacher's desk.
There is a duster next to the board.
We love our classroom!
translations: Kaç tane ışık var? Dört tane ışık var.
Maya'nın masasında bir kalem ve bir cetvel var.
Leo'nun bir ders kitabı ve bir çalışma kitabı var.
Öğretmen masasının yanında bir çöp kutusu var.
Tahtanın yanında bir tahta silgisi var.

scan.subtitle: Find the right device or number!

There is a computer on the teacher's desk.
The computer has a keyboard and a mouse.
There is a microphone next to the computer.
How many tablets are there? There are twenty tablets.
Maya asks: What are they?
They are keyboards, says Leo.
How many keyboards are there? There are twenty keyboards.
Ms. Hart has a microphone in her hand.
There are thirty students in our class.
Every student has a coursebook.
What are they? They are coursebooks!
translations: Bilgisayarın bir klavyesi ve bir faresi var.
Kaç tablet var? Yirmi tablet var.
Kaç klavye var? Yirmi klavye var.
Ms. Hart'ın elinde bir mikrofon var.
Her öğrencinin bir ders kitabı var.

scan.title: What Lesson Is It?
scan.subtitle: Find the right lesson or day!
sentences: Today is Monday.
What lesson is it now? It is Maths.
Leo asks: Is there a Music lesson today?
Yes, there is. It is after lunch.
What lesson is it now? It is English.
Maya loves English!
Is there a Life Study lesson on Tuesday? Yes, there is.
Is there a Sports lesson now? No, there isn't.
What lesson is it? It is Turkish.
Leo says: PE is my favourite lesson!
Ms. Hart says: Now it is time for English. Let's start!
translations: Şu an hangi ders? Matematik dersi.
Leo soruyor: Bugün Müzik dersi var mı?
Şu an hangi ders? İngilizce dersi.
Salı günü Hayat Bilgisi dersi var mı? Evet, var.
Şu an Beden Eğitimi dersi var mı? Hayır, yok.
Leo diyor: Beden Eğitimi benim en sevdiğim ders!
Ms. Hart diyor: Şimdi İngilizce zamanı. Hadi başlayalım!

skim.title: What's the Weather Today?
skim.subtitle: Read quickly and find the main idea!
sentences: Ms. Hart says: Look outside!
Maya looks outside. It is sunny and warm today.
What nice weather! says Maya.
Leo looks outside. It is windy, too.
In winter, it is cold and it is snowing.
It's freezing! says Leo.
In spring, it is sunny and warm.
In autumn, it is windy and it is raining.
Ms. Hart asks: How is the weather today?
It is sunny and warm! say Maya and Leo.
What nice weather! says Ms. Hart.
translations: Maya dışarıya bakıyor. Bugün güneşli ve ılık.
Ms. Hart soruyor: Bugün hava nasıl?
Güneşli ve ılık! diyor Maya ve Leo.
Ne güzel hava! diyor Ms. Hart.

questions.q: What is the text mainly about?
questions.hint: Think about what Maya, Leo and Ms. Hart talk about.

int.subtitle: Read carefully and answer the questions!
sentences: Ms. Hart says: Let's start the lesson!
Take your seat, please!
Open your book, please!
Open page twenty in your books, please!
Listen and repeat, please!
The pupils listen and repeat.
Ms. Hart says: Work in pairs, please!
Maya and Leo work together.
Ms. Hart asks: Have you finished?
Not yet! says Leo.
Ms. Hart says: Speak louder, please!
Leo speaks louder. That's correct! says Ms. Hart.
Ms. Hart says: Nice job, everyone! Last five minutes!
translations: Ms. Hart diyor: Hadi derse başlayalım!
Ms. Hart diyor: Çiftler halinde çalışın, lütfen!
Ms. Hart diyor: Daha yüksek sesle konuşun, lütfen!
Leo daha yüksek sesle konuşuyor. Doğru! diyor Ms. Hart.
Ms. Hart diyor: Aferin herkese! Son beş dakika!

int.title: What Time Is It?
int.subtitle: Read carefully and answer the questions!
sentences: Leo looks at the clock.
What time is it? It is eight o'clock.
It is time for the first lesson now.
What lesson is it? It is Maths.
At nine o'clock, it is English.
Maya asks: What time is it now?
It is ten o'clock, says Ms. Hart.
What lesson is it now? It is Life Study.
Leo asks: Is there a Music lesson today?
Yes, there is. It is at two o'clock.
Ms. Hart says: The winner of today's quiz gets a prize!
Leo says: I want to win a point!
Maya says: Me too. That's right!
translations: Maya soruyor: Şu an saat kaç?
Şu an hangi ders? Hayat Bilgisi.
Leo soruyor: Bugün Müzik dersi var mı?
Ms. Hart diyor: Bugünkü yarışmanın galibi ödül kazanır!
Leo diyor: Ben puan kazanmak istiyorum!

int.title: A Classroom Quiz
int.subtitle: Read carefully and answer the questions!
sentences: Ms. Hart says: Answer the question, please!
She holds up some flashcards.
What are they? They are flashcards.
Leo has a paintbrush in his school bag.
What are they? They are paintbrushes.
Maya has an exercise book on her desk.
What are they? They are exercise books.
Ms. Hart points to the white-blackboard.
There are forty words on the white-blackboard.
Spell the word, please! says Ms. Hart.
Leo spells the word. That's right! says Ms. Hart.
Maya answers the next question. Perfect! says Ms. Hart.
Everything is all right! say Maya and Leo.
You look great today, everyone! says Ms. Hart.
translations: Ms. Hart diyor: Soruyu cevaplayın, lütfen!
Leo'nun okul çantasında bir resim fırçası var.
Maya'nın masasında bir alıştırma defteri var.
Kelimeyi hece hece söyle, lütfen! diyor Ms. Hart.
Leo kelimeyi hece hece söylüyor. Doğru! diyor Ms. Hart.
Maya bir sonraki soruyu cevaplıyor. Mükemmel! diyor Ms. Hart.
Her şey yolunda! diyor Maya ve Leo.
Bugün harika görünüyorsunuz, herkes! diyor Ms. Hart.

inf.title: The Mystery Lesson
inf.subtitle: Use the clues to find the answer!
sentences: It is nine o'clock now.
Ms. Hart says: Take your seat, please!
She puts some paintbrushes on the desks.
What are they? asks Leo.
They are paintbrushes, says Maya.
Ms. Hart puts some flashcards on the board.
The flashcards have dark blue and light green colours.
Leo asks: What lesson is it now?
Ms. Hart says: Look at the paintbrushes!
Maya thinks: There are paintbrushes and flashcards with colours.
Maya says: I know! It is an Art lesson!
Ms. Hart smiles: That's correct! Nice job, Maya!
translations: Ms. Hart diyor: Yerinize oturun, lütfen!
Masaların üzerine bazı resim fırçaları koyuyor.
Ms. Hart tahtaya bazı kartlar koyuyor.
Kartlarda koyu mavi ve açık yeşil renkler var.
Leo soruyor: Şu an hangi ders?
Ms. Hart diyor: Resim fırçalarına bak!
Maya düşünüyor: Resim fırçaları ve renkli kartlar var.
Ms. Hart gülümsüyor: Doğru! Aferin, Maya!

questions.hint: Find the word desks in the text.

questions.q: What colours are on the flashcards?
questions.hint: Find the word flashcards in the text.

questions.q: How does Maya know it is an Art lesson?
questions.correct: She sees the paintbrushes and coloured flashcards.
wrong: She reads it on the board.
questions.hint: Read what Maya thinks before her answer.

questions.q: What lesson is it?
questions.hint: Think about what clues Ms. Hart gives.

inf.title: Who Wins the Prize?
inf.subtitle: Use the clues to find the answer!
sentences: It is two o'clock. It is Music lesson now.
Ms. Hart says: Answer the question, please!
There are twenty questions in the quiz.
Leo answers fifteen questions correctly.
Maya answers eighteen questions correctly.
Ms. Hart says: Try again, Leo!
Leo tries again and gets two more points.
Leo has seventeen points now.
Maya has eighteen points.
Ms. Hart asks: Who is the winner?
Leo thinks: Maya has more points than me.
Leo says: Maya is the winner!
That's correct! says Ms. Hart. Here is your prize, Maya!
Nice job, everyone! says Ms. Hart.
translations: Ms. Hart diyor: Soruyu cevaplayın, lütfen!
Leo on beş soruyu doğru cevaplıyor.
Maya on sekiz soruyu doğru cevaplıyor.
Ms. Hart diyor: Tekrar dene, Leo!
Leo tekrar deniyor ve iki puan daha alıyor.
Leo'nun şimdi on yedi puanı var.
Leo düşünüyor: Maya'nın benden daha fazla puanı var.
Doğru! diyor Ms. Hart. İşte ödülün, Maya!
